title: Corneal endothelial cell changes in diabetics versus age group matched nondiabetics after manual small incision cataract surgery

indication: Senile uncomplicated cataract, age 50 to 80 years, in diabetic patients (duration of diabetes and HbA1c in Table 1) and age-group-matched nondiabetic patients; glaucoma, uveitis or trauma, previous ocular surgery, other systemic illness, corneal opacity, contact lens wear, age-related macular degeneration and traumatic cataract excluded

groups.description: Manual small incision cataract surgery: 6.5-mm scleral incision, capsulorrhexis, nucleus prolapsed into the anterior chamber and delivered with an irrigating wire vectis, single-piece PMMA IOL in the bag; single experienced surgeon, peribulbar anesthesia

groups.indication: no diabetes (casual blood glucose test; patient-condition subgroup)
groups.description: Same manual small incision cataract surgery by the same surgeon in age-group-matched patients without diabetes

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT (Table 2 row CCT 'Mean±SD', column Diabetic 'Preop'); noncontact specular microscope (Tomey EM-4000)
series.notes: Table 2 columns Preop, 1 month, 3 months postop of the Diabetic block; mean ± SD in µm; per-visit n not reported

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT (Table 2 row CCT 'Mean±SD', column Non Diabetic 'Preop'); noncontact specular microscope (Tomey EM-4000)
series.notes: Table 2 columns Preop, 1 month, 3 months postop of the Non Diabetic block; mean ± SD in µm; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: Table 2 rows 'Max' and 'Min' under CCT (R6, R7)
Table 2 rows ECD, CV and Hexagonal Cells; Table 3 (ECD by duration of diabetes)
CCT at postoperative day 1 and week 1 (assessments mentioned in Methods and Abstract)
exclusions.reason: No values tabulated for these visits

notes: Prospective observational comparative study, November 2017 to November 2018: 106 eyes (54 diabetic, 52 nondiabetic) of 106 patients.

Role: diabetes defines patient-condition subgroups operated with the same standard technique, so both groups are control with the condition in 'indication'; the nondiabetic eyes are operated eyes, not unoperated controls.

Method: Methods name only the noncontact specular microscope (Tomey EM-4000) for the corneal assessments, and Table 2 lists CCT among the endothelial parameters; the CCT device is not stated separately, so 'specular' is inferred. Flagged for review.
Statistics used the Mann-Whitney U test; Table 2 reports mean ± SD.
